company.description: Method Security is a developer of an AI security platform designed to protect enterprise AI applications, models, and agentic workflows. The company provides AI risk assessments, red teaming, continuous security monitoring, vulnerability detection, and governance tools, enabling organizations to identify threats, validate AI deployments, and strengthen the security of AI systems.
